experiment.hypothesis: ETH-USD hourly price deviations from a 24-hour moving average revert to the mean with a 3% threshold, exhibiting statistically significant mean reversion with an R-squared of at least 0.30 and a Sharpe ratio of at least 0.5 over a 30-day rolling wind

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If the R-squared of the mean reversion model is below 0.30 across at least 30 days of ETH-USD hourly data, or if the Sharpe ratio is less than 0.5 and RMSE exceeds 5% of the price range, the hypothesis is falsified.
